title: Haar bases for multi-parameter twisted structures
summary: Motivated by the Cauchy--Szegő projections on a broad class of Siegel domains and the geometric quotient structures of nilpotent Lie groups observed by Nagel, Ricci, and Stein, we develop a martingale and Haar wavelet framework for twisted multi-parameter geometries. We introduce twisted dyadic filtrations and construct adapted Haar bases on Euclidean spaces $\mathbb{R}^{2m}$. Each of the resulting dyadic systems forms a complete orthonormal basis of $L^2(\mathbb R^{2m})$, and their union yields a tight frame with frame bound $3$.
